subject: Data Engineering
title: Evaluating Cloud Services
description: A fast breakdown of Evaluating Cloud Services for builders.

hook.text: The vendor demo was impressive. But demos always are. How do you actually evaluate a cloud data service?

buildup.text: Start with requirements: latency, throughput, cost ceiling, compliance, and integration with existing tools.

discovery.text: Run a proof of concept on real data with real queries. Benchmarks in marketing slides don't tell the truth.

twist.text: The best technology can fail if the team can't learn it. Adoption difficulty kills more tools than performance.

climax.text: Evaluate on total cost of ownership: licensing, compute, engineering time, training, and migration risk.

punchline.text: Test on your data. Not on the vendor's demo.

quiz.question: What should a proof of concept use to evaluate a cloud service?
options: Real data with real queries from your workload
